customers_say: Customers find this water purifier to be among the best in the market, appreciating its transparent pricing and budget-friendly nature. The installation process receives positive feedback, with one customer noting it's very simple to set up. The water quality is excellent, making a noticeable difference, and customers like the taste, describing it as sweet. While many customers report no issues, some mention the purifier stops working.
